code2='''def transform(grid):
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        obj = [[color if grid[r][c] == color else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
        objects.append((r0, c0, obj))
    rows = [r for r, c, obj in objects]
    cols = [c for r, c, obj in objects]
    vertical = (max(rows) - min(rows)) > (max(cols) - min(cols))

        objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
        width = max(len(obj[0]) for r, c, obj in objects)
        out = []
        for r, c, obj in objects:
            for row in obj:
                out.append(row + [0] * (width - len(row)))
        return out
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
    height = max(len(obj) for r, c, obj in objects)
    width = sum(len(obj[0]) for r, c, obj in objects)

    offset = 0
    for r, c, obj in objects:
        for i, row in enumerate(obj):
